generation_parents.algorithm: The heuristic scores each feasible unvisited customer by the current distance from the vehicle plus a demand-aware penalty encouraging fuller loads, then selects the minimum-scoring customer deterministically.

Use a regret-based scoring that balances proximity to the current node with savings from serving a customer now versus letting it fall to a later trip, selecting the feasible customer maximizing the combined benefit.

generation_parents.algorithm: The heuristic evaluates each feasible customer by how much it improves the classical Clarke–Wright savings value relative to a route that would otherwise pair it with the depot, using an angle-based detour factor between the current node and depot so distant/low-saving customers are deferred, then picks the maximum-score customer.

Use a regret-based scoring that balances proximity to the current node with savings from serving a customer now versus letting it fall to a later trip, selecting the feasible customer maximizing the combined benefit.
